realm.name: job:teller
realm.description: Branch teller (PRD §2). Takes cash and moves money; reads customers and products to do it, and changes neither.

realm.name: job:supervisor
realm.description: Branch supervisor. A teller plus the judgement calls: approvals, and business reversal. Maker-checker still forbids approving your own.

realm.name: job:ops
realm.description: Operations. Works the unresolved-outcome queue and watches what was and was not sent. Cannot declare an outcome — only the ledger can.

realm.name: job:compliance
realm.description: Compliance officer (PRD §2). Reads customers and moves KYC tiers with a reason; records consent. Moves no money.

realm.name: job:admin
realm.description: MFB administrator / Head of Operations. Configures the institution: customers, products, message templates and delivery policy. Deliberately holds no money permission.

realm.name: job:api-partner
realm.description: A third party the tenant authorised (PRD §4.7.3). The narrowest useful grant: initiate and read transfers, read customers. Scoped and revocable by the tenant.

realm.name: machine:notification
realm.description: What the Notification service needs and nothing more: contact details and consent for an account holder. No name, no tier, no money.
